# 05. API and API management

## 1. Principles

- REST over HTTPS, JSON bodies, base path `/api/v1`. The FastAPI app generates OpenAPI 3.1 at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. The OpenAPI file is the contract for the frontend and for customers.
- Long work is asynchronous: create a run, then follow it through server-sent events (SSE) or polling.
- Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
- Every response carries `X-Request-ID` (generated by nginx or the API if absent).
- Authentication is required for everything except `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/api/v1/auth/*` and `/metrics` (which is served on an internal port in server mode).

## 2. Authentication

| Method | Used by | Mechanics |
|---|---|---|
| Session (browser) | SPA | `POST /auth/login` returns an access JWT in the body and sets a refresh cookie `df_refresh` (httpOnly, Secure in server mode, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1/auth). Access token kept in memory, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` |
| Refresh | SPA | `POST /auth/refresh` reads the cookie, rotates it (new token, old one revoked, same `family_id`). Reuse of a revoked token revokes the whole family |
| OIDC SSO | SPA | `GET /auth/oidc/login` redirects to the IdP, `GET /auth/oidc/callback` creates or links the user, then same as session |
| API key | Integrations | `Authorization: Bearer df_live_<32 random url-safe chars>`. Looked up by sha256. Scopes checked per route |
| Lite mode | Local user | First start creates a local owner account and prints a one-time login link. Binding is `127.0.0.1` by default |

JWT claims: `sub` (user id), `org` (active org id), `role`, `exp`, `iat`, `jti`. Signed HS256 with `DF_JWT_SECRET`. Lifetime `DF_JWT_ACCESS_TTL_S`.

### 2.1 Roles and permissions

| Action | viewer | editor | admin | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Read projects, runs, decks | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Create projects, upload files, create runs, give feedback | | yes | yes | yes |
| Manage templates and design systems | | yes | yes | yes |
| Manage members, API keys, provider credentials, org settings | | | yes | yes |
| Delete org, transfer ownership | | | | yes |

API key scopes: `runs:read`, `runs:write`, `files:write`, `projects:write`, `admin`. A key acts with the minimum of its scopes and the role of the user who created it.

## 3. Endpoints

All paths are under `/api/v1`. "Async" means the response returns immediately and work continues in a job.

### 3.1 Auth and identity

| Method | Path | Body or query | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/login` | `{email, password}` | `{access_token, expires_in, user, orgs}` + cookie |
| POST | `/auth/refresh` | cookie | `{access_token, expires_in}` + rotated cookie |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | cookie | 204, family revoked |
| GET | `/auth/oidc/login` | `?org=<slug>` | 302 |
| GET | `/auth/oidc/callback` | IdP params | 302 to SPA with session |
| GET | `/me` | | `{user, memberships}` |
| POST | `/me/switch-org` | `{org_id}` | new access token |

### 3.2 Organisation administration

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET, PATCH | `/org` | settings: `default_family`, `research_enabled`, `retention_days`, `model_profile`, `allow_training` (local head and adapter jobs on this install, `19`), `allow_exploration` (counterfactual exploration on internal eval runs only, `24`), `fix_minor` |
| GET, POST | `/org/members` | invite by email (creates user with a set-password link in server mode) |
| PATCH, DELETE | `/org/members/{user_id}` | change role, remove |
| GET, POST | `/org/api-keys` | POST returns the full key once |
| DELETE | `/org/api-keys/{id}` | revoke |
| GET, POST, DELETE | `/org/credentials` | search and connector credentials, value never returned |
| GET | `/org/usage?from&to` | aggregated `usage_ledger` |
| GET | `/org/audit?cursor` | audit log |

### 3.3 Projects, files, templates

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET, POST | `/projects` | list (cursor pagination), create `{name, description}` |
| GET, PATCH, DELETE | `/projects/{id}` | DELETE is async (`project.purge`) |
| POST | `/projects/{id}/files` | multipart `file`, form field `kind` (`data`, `template`, `reference`, `image`). Async processing: `file.profile` for data, `template.ingest` for templates, `reference.extract` for documents. Returns `File` with `status=processing` |
| GET | `/projects/{id}/files` | list |
| GET | `/files/{id}` | metadata, profile when ready |
| PATCH | `/files/{id}/profile` | user corrections to column semantic types and units (feeds Laya training) |
| DELETE | `/files/{id}` | |
| GET | `/design-systems` | built-in families + org templates |
| GET, PATCH | `/design-systems/{id}` | PATCH edits colours, fonts, layout map, creates a new version |
| GET | `/design-systems/{id}/preview` | PNG of a sample slide set |

### 3.4 Briefs and runs

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/projects/{id}/briefs` | body `BriefCreate` (Brief without ids). Returns `Brief` |
| GET, PATCH | `/briefs/{id}` | |
| POST | `/runs` | `{brief_id, options}` with header `Idempotency-Key` (required). Returns `Run` 202. Async |
| GET | `/runs?project_id&status&cursor` | list |
| GET | `/runs/{id}` | status, stage, pending_input, timings, latest deck version |
| POST | `/runs/{id}/events/token` | Returns `{token, expires_in: 60}`: a signed, single-run token for `EventSource`, which cannot send an `Authorization` header |
| GET | `/runs/{id}/events` | SSE stream (section 4). Auth by Bearer header or `?token=` from the endpoint above. Query `?after=<seq>` with `Accept: application/json` returns a JSON list for polling clients |
| POST | `/runs/{id}/resume` | body is the response to `pending_input` (section 3.5). 202. Async |
| POST | `/runs/{id}/cancel` | sets `cancel_requested`. 202 |
| GET | `/runs/{id}/plan` | latest Plan |
| GET | `/runs/{id}/decks` | deck versions |
| GET | `/runs/{id}/decks/{version}` | slides with preview URLs, QA report |
| POST | `/runs/{id}/slides/{slide_key}/regenerate` | `{instruction, keep_exhibit: bool}`. Creates a new deck version through `slide_regen_graph`. Async |
| POST | `/runs/{id}/feedback` | `{slide_key?, rating, comment?, action}` |
| GET | `/artifacts/{id}/download` | 302 to a signed URL (S3) or streamed file (fs). `Content-Disposition: attachment` |

`RunOptions`:

```json
{
  "auto_approve": false,
  "ask_clarifications": true,
  "family": null,
  "model_profile": null,
  "max_repair_rounds": 2,
  "variants_for": ["exec_summary"],
  "research": null
}
```

`null` means "use the brief or org default".

### 3.5 Interrupt payloads and resume bodies

When a run is `waiting_input`, `GET /runs/{id}` returns `pending_input`:

| `pending_input.kind` | Payload | Resume body |
|---|---|---|
| `clarify` | `{questions: [{id, question, why, options?: [str]}]}` | `{kind: "clarify", answers: {<id>: "<text>"}}` |
| `plan_review` | `{plan: Plan (without slides content), slide_plan: [...], notes}` | `{kind: "plan_review", action: "approve"}` or `{kind: "plan_review", action: "edit", plan: <edited Plan>}` or `{kind: "plan_review", action: "revise", instruction: "<text>"}` |
| `final_review` (optional) | `{deck_version, qa_summary}` | `{kind: "final_review", action: "accept"}` or `{action: "repair", slide_keys: [...], instruction}` |

Resume validation: the body `kind` must match `pending_input.kind`, else 409.

### 3.6 Health and operations

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/healthz` | liveness, no dependencies |
| GET | `/readyz` | database, cache, blob store reachable. Lists degraded optional services (laya, renderer, search) |
| GET | `/api/v1/system/info` | version, mode, enabled features (for the SPA) |
| GET | `/metrics` | Prometheus, internal port `9100` in server mode |

## 4. Server-sent events

`GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/events` with `Accept: text/event-stream`.

- On connect: the API sends all stored events with `seq > Last-Event-ID` (header) or `> after` (query) from `run_events`, then relays live events from the `EventBus` channel `run:{run_id}`.
- Each event: `id: <seq>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <RunEvent JSON>`.
- Ping comment every 15 s (`sse-starlette` `ping=15`).
- The stream ends after `run.status` with a terminal status (`succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`) or after 1 hour (client reconnects).
- The worker writes the event row first, then publishes. A reconnecting client never misses an event.

Event payload `data` by type:

| Type | data |
|---|---|
| `run.status` | `{status, stage}` |
| `stage.started` / `stage.completed` | `{stage, duration_ms?}` |
| `node.progress` | `{node, done, total, label}` |
| `question.asked` | `{questions}` (same as `pending_input`) |
| `plan.ready` | `{sections, slide_count}` |
| `slide.composed` | `{slide_key, title, exhibit}` |
| `slide.rendered` | `{slide_key, position, preview_url}` |
| `qa.defect` | `Defect` |
| `artifact.ready` | `{artifact_id, kind, url}` |
| `run.error` | `{code, message, retryable}` |
| `usage.update` | `{input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_micro_usd}` |

## 5. Errors

```json
{
  "type": "https://deckforge.dev/errors/quota-exceeded",
  "title": "Quota exceeded",
  "status": 429,
  "detail": "Monthly run quota of 200 reached for this organisation.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/runs",
  "code": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
  "request_id": "01J..."
}
```

| HTTP | `code` values |
|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` (with `errors: [{loc, msg}]`), `UNSUPPORTED_FILE`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `TOKEN_EXPIRED` |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN`, `SCOPE_MISSING`, `TRAINING_DISABLED` |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` (also for rows of other orgs, never 403, to avoid leaking existence) |
| 409 | `CONFLICT`, `RUN_NOT_WAITING`, `RESUME_KIND_MISMATCH`, `IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY` (returns the original run) |
| 413 | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (nginx may answer first) |
| 422 | `PLAN_INVALID` (edited plan fails validation) |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` (with `Retry-After`), `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `ORG_RUN_LIMIT` |
| 503 | `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` |

## 6. API management

### 6.1 Rate limits (two layers)

| Layer | Where | Limit | Key |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coarse | nginx `limit_req` | 20 r/s burst 40 for `/api/`, 5 r/min burst 5 for `/api/v1/auth/login` | client IP |
| Fine | API middleware, Valkey token bucket (lite: in-memory) | values from `config/limits.yaml` | `org:{id}`, `user:{id}`, `key:{id}` |

`config/limits.yaml` (defaults):

```yaml
rate:
  default_rps_per_user: 10
  runs_per_hour_per_user: 20
  uploads_per_hour_per_user: 60
  regenerate_per_hour_per_user: 60
quota:            # per org per calendar month, 0 = unlimited
  runs: 0
  llm_output_tokens: 0
  storage_gb: 50
runs:
  org_max_active: 5          # DF_ORG_MAX_ACTIVE_RUNS overrides
  max_slides: 40
  max_data_files_per_brief: 10
```

Token bucket algorithm in Valkey: one Lua script `deckforge/api/ratelimit.lua` (refill rate, capacity, cost) called with `EVALSHA`. Response headers: `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`.

### 6.2 Quotas and usage

- Every billable event writes `usage_ledger` (runs started, LLM tokens per call, renders, storage delta).
- Quota check at run creation and before each LLM call batch (cheap aggregate cached in Valkey for 60 s).
- The `ModelPool` token budget semaphore (`22`, section 6) is the second guard: a run that exceeds `max_tokens_total` gets `budget_exhausted` and the run ends gracefully with what it has.

### 6.3 Idempotency

`POST /runs` and `POST /runs/{id}/slides/{key}/regenerate` require `Idempotency-Key` (UUID). The pair (org, key) is unique in `runs.idempotency_key`. A replay within 24 h returns the original response with 200 and header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

### 6.4 Pagination

Cursor-based: `?limit=50&cursor=<opaque>`. Response `{items: [...], next_cursor: "..." | null}`. Cursor encodes `(created_at, id)` base64.

### 6.5 Versioning and deprecation

- Path version `/api/v1`. Additive changes (new fields, new endpoints) do not bump the version.
- Breaking changes go to `/api/v2` with `/api/v1` kept for 12 months. Deprecated endpoints send `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers.

### 6.6 Webhooks (integrations)

Org admins register `POST /org/webhooks {url, events: ["run.succeeded", "run.failed"], secret}`. Delivery job `webhook.deliver`: JSON body `{event, run_id, org_id, at, data}`, header `X-DeckForge-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac_sha256(secret, t + "." + body)>`. Retries with backoff 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h, then dead. URL passes the same SSRF guard as research fetch (private ranges blocked unless `allow_private_webhooks`). Table `app.webhooks` (id, org_id, url, events text[], secret_ciphertext, nonce, active, created_at) is added in T-10.8.

### 6.7 CORS and CSRF

- Same-origin by default (SPA served by the same host). `DF_CORS_ORIGINS` enables listed origins for API-key clients only.
- Refresh cookie is SameSite=Strict and scoped to `/api/v1/auth`, so CSRF cannot use it. Mutating endpoints accept only Bearer tokens, never cookies.

### 6.8 Upload rules

- Max size `DF_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` (nginx `client_max_body_size` must match).
- Allowed: xlsx, csv, pptx, potx, pdf, docx, png, jpg, svg (svg sanitised). Rejected: xlsm, pptm, docm, any macro-enabled or encrypted Office file, executables.
- Validation pipeline in `deckforge/security/uploads.py` (`15`, section 4).

## 7. Router layout in code

```text
deckforge/api/
  app.py            # create_app(settings) -> FastAPI. Mounts routers, middleware, static SPA (lite)
  deps.py           # get_session, get_current_principal, require_role, require_scope, get_ports
  errors.py         # exception handlers -> problem+json
  middleware.py     # request id, structlog context, rate limit, timing
  ratelimit.py + ratelimit.lua
  sse.py            # event stream helper
  schemas/          # request and response models (never reuse DB models)
  routers/ auth.py org.py projects.py files.py design.py briefs.py runs.py artifacts.py system.py
```

Every router function: validates input with a schema, loads rows through a repository that filters by `principal.org_id`, performs one unit of work in a transaction, enqueues jobs after commit (outbox pattern: the job row is inserted in the same transaction, so a crash cannot lose it).

Endpoints added by the user stories (revisions, slide copy edits, variants, diffs, restore, exports, shares, comments, approval, org knowledge, notifications, A2A) are listed in `26`, section 8, with the story each one serves. They live in routers `revisions.py`, `variants.py`, `comments.py`, `shares.py`, `exports.py`, `knowledge.py` and `a2a.py`, and follow the same rules as above.
